instruction: I'm reviewing this course outline and want to make the first paragraph stand out. Can you apply italic formatting to the entire first paragraph?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires applying italic formatting to all text in the first paragraph. Evaluator checks if all runs in the first paragraph have italic formatting. Similar complexity to original task.

Metric logic correctly checks if all text runs in the first paragraph have italic formatting
Postconfig properly saves the file before verification, ensuring modified state is captured
Complete coverage: the single requirement (italicize entire first paragraph) is fully verified
Expected parameter handling is correct: function receives empty rules dict directly and doesn't need to use it

Consider handling None explicitly: 'if run.font.italic is not True:' instead of 'if not run.font.italic:' to avoid potential false negatives when italic is inherited from paragraph style
Edge case: If first paragraph has no runs at all, the function returns 1.0 (success). Consider returning 0.0 for empty paragraphs to be more strict
